data.name: Fremont
data.gender_notes: Fremont is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: John C. Frémont was an American explorer and the first presidential candidate of the Republican Party. The name Fremont is derived from his surname and means 'explorer'. The name Fremont carries the meaning “Explorer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Fremont usually hope their child will grow to embody explorer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing curiosity, adventure, and discovery in life.
data.etymology: Fremont belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Explorer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fremont total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: פרמונט
in_hebrew.meaning: פרמונט - שם שאינו מקורב במילון העברי התנ״כי אך קרוב ל׳פר׳ ו׳מונט׳
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פרמונט הוא שם שמקורו אינו תנ״כי אך ניתן לפרש אותו כ׳פר׳ - הפתח או הגבול ו׳מונט׳ - ההר או הצד. כך ניתן לראות בפרמונט כמי שמגיע מההר או הצד של הפתח או הגבול. אין אזכור תנ״כי לשם זה אך הוא עשוי להיות קשור למושגים הקשורים בפתח, גבול והר.

in_latin.name: Fremont
in_latin.meaning: Fremont - locus liberorum, free place or mountain of freedom
in_latin.long_meaning: Fremont, a name likely derived from the Old French 'franc' and 'mont', suggesting a free or open place, possibly a hill or mountain. While not directly mentioned in Christian scripture, it conveys a sense of liberation and openness associated with Christian values of freedom in Christ.

in_english.name: Fremont
in_english.long_meaning: Fremont, a name with French origins, combining 'franc' or 'free' and 'mont' meaning mountain or hill. It signifies a place of freedom or an open highland. While not directly biblical, it echoes Christian themes of spiritual freedom. Historically, Fremont has been used as a surname and place name, notably in the United States.
